publications.title: MRD-guided discontinuation in sustained responders: a prospective cohort
publications.abstract: Among 94 sustained responders meeting MRD-negativity criteria, therapy was discontinued under protocol. The analysis addresses feasibility; it is not powered for safety of discontinuation.

publications.title: Treatment burden in relapsed myeloma: patient-reported outcomes
publications.abstract: Treatment burden was the dominant driver of stated preference, ahead of response depth.
